summary: Smith & Nephew filed a 6-K reporting the results of its cash tender offer for up to $250 million of its 2.032% senior notes due 2030. The offer expired on September 15, 2026, with $431.825 million validly tendered, exceeding the maximum amount, resulting in a 57.995% scaling factor. Accepted notes will be purchased at $878.90 per $1,000 principal amount, plus accrued interest, with settlement expected September 18, 2026. BofA Merrill Lynch acted as dealer manager. Post-tender, $650 million remains outstanding, and the company may repurchase additional notes.
